answer: One production cockpit/statusline render performs 0 external PATH-visible child spawns (ceiling 2); under ceiling=True. Count is from a PATH shim first proven to catch a known `true` spawn (shim_count=1), then shown to increment 0->1 when one extra spawn is inserted. A grep of tools/hud/statusline.py is not the detector (jq/sleep words occur in comments: {'git': 0, 'jq': 4, 'sleep': 5, 'true': 3}). Independent OS-level strace process-clones over the same pair moved 0->1. Slow render CANCELLED: shim 1 < uncancelled 2 (remaining helper not launched). SUCCESS:TST-0238
